Cors._comment: Trusted browser origins for the deployed frontend (used outside Development). Set via Cors__AllowedOrigins__0, Cors__AllowedOrigins__1, ... e.g. https://app.example.com

RateLimiting._comment: Auth: per-client-IP throttle for the unauthenticated auth endpoints (login/register/create-group/refresh). Ocr: per-admin throttle for the CPU-bound Tesseract image upload. OcrImage: per-admin throttle for reading stored upload images (a gallery issues many cheap reads).

OcrStorage._comment: Uploaded OCR images are stored in Postgres, so they ride along in every backup. StoreImages is the kill switch (OCR still works when off); MaxImagesPerRound prunes on upload; RetentionDays drives the daily sweep (0 = keep forever). Pruning removes only the bytes — batches, candidates and audit stay.
